tools.name: list_calculators
tools.description: Every UsePhysics calculator: id (slug), name, category, formula, inputs (key, unit, default) and page URL. Optional category filter.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run one calculator by id with numeric inputs (keys from list_calculators, in the listed units). Returns every result with its unit, the formula, the Given → Formula → Substitute → Result working when the engine can derive it, and the URL of the solved page.

tools.name: get_constant
tools.description: One CODATA 2022 constant by id, symbol or name (e.g. 'c', 'speed of light', 'planck-constant'): value as NIST prints it, machine-readable value, standard uncertainty (null = exact), unit, note, page and NIST source.

tools.name: list_constants
tools.description: The CODATA 2022 constants UsePhysics keeps, grouped; optional group id filter. Values are NIST's.
